canaries.d: Mount Teide (walk-up summit; strenuous by the Montana Blanca route, or a short climb from the cable car; summit permit required, May-Oct); Roques de Garcia (loop, about 2 miles, easy, year-round); Anaga Mountains laurel forest (loop, about 5 to 8 miles, steady, year-round)
canaries.m: GR 131 across the islands (multi-day, guesthouses, trek, Mar-Jun and Sep-Nov)

cape-cod-islands.d: Great Island Trail in Wellfleet (loop, about 8 miles through soft sand, steady, Apr-Oct); Atlantic White Cedar Swamp Trail (loop, about 1 mile, easy, year-round); Beech Forest Trail (loop, about 1 mile, easy, year-round)

cape-town.d: Platteklip Gorge up Table Mountain (walk-up summit, about 2 miles one way, steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Lion's Head (out and back, about 3.5 miles, steep, year-round); Cape of Good Hope fynbos paths (loop, 2 to 6 miles, easy to steady, year-round)

chamonix.d: Lac Blanc from La Flegere (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Grand Balcon Sud from Plan de l'Aiguille to Montenvers (point to point, about 4 to 5 miles, steady, Jun-Sep)
chamonix.m: Tour du Mont Blanc (10 to 12 days, about 105 miles, mountain huts and guesthouses, trek, mid-Jun to mid-Sep)

champagne.d: Montagne de Reims vineyard loops (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Faux de Verzy twisted beech trail (loop, short, easy, year-round)

charleston-savannah.d: Skidaway Island State Park nature trails (loop, about 2 to 3 miles, easy, Oct-May); Caw Caw Interpretive Center boardwalks (loop, about 1 to 3 miles, easy, Oct-May)

chiang-mai.d: Kew Mae Pan nature trail in Doi Inthanon (loop, about 2 miles, steady, Nov-May; guide required); Monthathan Waterfall trail on Doi Suthep (out and back, short, easy, year-round)
chiang-mai.m: Hill-village treks around Chiang Mai (2 to 3 days, village homestays, trek, Nov-Feb)

chiapas.d: El Chiflon waterfalls (out and back, about 2 miles, easy, Nov-Apr); Lagunas de Montebello lake paths (loop, easy, Nov-Apr); Lacandon jungle day hikes (guided, steady, Nov-Apr)

chicago.d: Cowles Bog Trail in Indiana Dunes (loop, about 4.7 miles, steady, Apr-Oct); West Beach Succession Trail (loop, about 1 mile, easy, Apr-Oct); Palos Trail System loops (loop, about 3 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Apr-Nov)

chilean-lake-district.d: Huerquehue Los Lagos trail (out and back, about 7 miles to the upper lakes, steady, Nov-Apr); Villarrica volcano (guided ascent with crampons, strenuous, Dec-Mar); Conguillio Sierra Nevada trail (out and back, steady to steep, Dec-Apr)

churchill.d: Guided tundra walks and short paths near town (guided, easy, Jul-Aug)

colombian-andes.d: Cocora Valley loop (loop, about 7 miles, steady, Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug); Los Nevados National Park paramo day hikes (steady to steep, Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug)
colombian-andes.m: Los Nevados National Park treks (2 to 5 days, camping, trek, Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug)
colombian-andes.st: El Cocuy National Park's trekking access has been restricted at times and sources conflict, so the text leaves it out; confirm before planning any Cocuy trek.

colombian-caribbean.d: Tayrona coastal trail to Cabo San Juan (point to point, about 3 miles, easy to steady, Dec-Apr)
colombian-caribbean.m: Ciudad Perdida (4 to 6 days, about 30 miles, simple camp lodgings, guide required, trek, Dec-Apr)
colombian-caribbean.st: Tayrona suspended visitor entry 1 to 15 June 2026 (Parques Nacionales report) and usually closes for a short period again around February and late October. The Ciudad Perdida trek is usually closed in September for maintenance (older operator sources); confirm with a licensed Santa Marta operator.

copenhagen.d: Jaegersborg Dyrehave (loop, about 5 miles, easy, year-round); Naturpark Amager paths (loop, about 4 miles, easy, year-round)

cornwall.d: Zennor to St Ives (point to point, about 6 miles, steady, Mar-Oct); Land's End to Porthcurno (point to point, about 5 miles, steady, Mar-Oct); Kynance Cove loop on the Lizard (loop, about 4 miles, easy to steady, Mar-Oct)
cornwall.m: Padstow to St Ives on the South West Coast Path (6 days, about 66 miles, B&Bs, trek, Apr-Oct)

costa-rica.d: Monteverde cloud forest and hanging bridges (loop, about 2 to 5 miles, easy to steady, Dec-Apr); Arenal volcano lava trails (loop, short, easy, Dec-Apr)
costa-rica.m: Cerro Chirripo (2 to 3 days, about 9 miles each way to base camp, mountain hostel, strenuous trek, Dec-Apr; permit required); Corcovado coast (3 to 4 days, guided, ranger stations, trek, Dec-Apr)

cotswolds.d: Broadway Tower circuit (loop, about 5 miles, easy to steady, Apr-Oct); Cleeve Hill ridge (loop, about 5 miles, steady, Apr-Oct)
cotswolds.m: Cotswold Way (7 to 10 days, 102 miles, B&Bs, trek, Apr-Oct)

croatia.d: Velika Paklenica gorge (out and back, steady, Apr-Oct); Plitvice Lakes boardwalk loops (loop, about 4 to 5 miles, easy, Apr-Oct); Biokovo ridge trails (out and back, steady to steep, May-Oct)
croatia.m: Premuzic Trail on Velebit (about 3 days, about 35 miles, mountain huts, trek, Jun-Sep)

death-valley.d: Golden Canyon to Red Cathedral (out and back, about 3 miles, steady, Oct-Apr); Mosaic Canyon (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Oct-Apr); Telescope Peak (walk-up summit, about 14 miles round trip, strenuous, Jun-Oct)
death-valley.st: Lower Wildrose Road reopened in 2026 as an unpaved route for vehicles under 25 feet after about three years closed; Scotty's Castle and Bonnie Clare roads were still closed for flood recovery in April 2026 (NPS). A November 2025 storm briefly closed many park roads. Check the NPS conditions page before driving to trailheads.

denali-interior.d: Mount Healy Overlook Trail (out and back, about 5.4 miles, steep, May-Sep); Savage River Loop (loop, about 2 miles, easy, May-Sep); Horseshoe Lake Trail (loop, about 3 miles, easy, May-Sep)
denali-interior.m: Backcountry unit treks off the park road (3 to 7 days, camping with a permit, trek, Jun-Sep)
denali-interior.st: The Pretty Rocks bridge was finished in September 2026 and is open to hikers and cyclists. Park buses still turn around at about Mile 43 (East Fork); bus service beyond it is planned for 2027 (NPS, Alaska Beacon, Sept 2026).

dolomites.d: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop (loop, about 6 miles, steady, Jun-Oct); Seceda ridge from the cable car (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, steady, Jun-Oct); Lago di Braies shore path (loop, about 2 miles, easy, Jun-Oct)
dolomites.m: Alta Via 1 (10 to 12 days, about 75 miles, mountain huts, trek, Jul-Sep)
dolomites.pm: Lago di Braies has summer car restrictions and a shuttle, Tre Cime di Lavaredo is reached by a toll road, and Seceda and Alpe di Siusi lifts can run timed slots in peak season.

douro-valley-porto.d: Douro terrace paths around Pinhao (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); Douro International Nature Park river-gorge trails (out and back, steady, Mar-Nov)

dubai.d: Hatta Wadi Hub marked trails (loop, about 2 to 6 miles, steady, Nov-Mar); Jebel Jais trails in Ras Al Khaimah (out and back, steady to steep, Nov-Mar)

ecuadorian-andes.d: Cotopaxi National Park Limpiopungo lagoon loop (loop, about 2 miles, easy, Jun-Sep and Dec-Jan); Cajas National Park lake trails (loop, about 3 to 8 miles, steady, Jun-Sep and Dec-Jan)
ecuadorian-andes.m: Quilotoa Loop (3 days, about 25 miles, village hostels, trek, Jun-Sep and Dec-Jan)
ecuadorian-andes.st: Cotopaxi National Park closed in late 2022 during a volcanic alert and later reopened; no 2026 status was found, so check Ecuador's environment ministry and the IGEPN alert level before planning Cotopaxi hikes.

edinburgh.d: Arthur's Seat by Salisbury Crags (loop, about 3 miles, steady, year-round); Allermuir and Caerketton Hills in the Pentlands (loop, about 4 miles, steep, year-round)

egypt.d: Mount Sinai (walk-up summit, about 4 to 7 miles round trip depending on the path, steep, Oct-Apr; Bedouin guide required); Colored Canyon (out and back, short, easy, Oct-Apr; 4x4 with a guide)

el-chalten.d: Laguna de los Tres (out and back, about 12 miles, steep, Oct-Apr); Laguna Torre (out and back, about 11 miles, steady, Oct-Apr); Loma del Pliegue Tumbado (out and back, about 13 miles, steep, Oct-Apr)
el-chalten.m: Huemul Circuit (4 days, about 40 miles, camping, trek, Nov-Mar)

ethiopia.d: Simien Mountains escarpment day hikes from Sankaber (out and back, steady, Oct-Mar; guide and armed scout required)
ethiopia.m: Simien plateau treks (3 to 6 days, camping, trek, Oct-Mar); Ras Dashen (about 5 to 6 days from Debark, camping, expedition trek, Oct-Dec)

everglades.d: Anhinga Trail (out and back boardwalk, about 0.8 miles, easy, Dec-Apr); Shark Valley loop (loop, 15 miles on a paved road, easy, Dec-Apr, walked or cycled)
